persona: Java backend engineer in e-commerce who owns product search and wants a search role
resumeText:
Ananya Rao | Bengaluru | ananya.rao@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Software Engineer, Kirana Basket Technologies, Bengaluru (2021 - present)
- Built product search APIs in Java and Spring Boot serving 2,000 queries per second.
- Maintain OpenSearch indices, custom analyzers and synonym lists for 4 lakh grocery products.
- Tuned BM25 field boosts and query rewriting to cut no-result searches from 9% to 4%.
- Stream catalogue price and stock updates to the index through Kafka consumers.
- Added Redis caching for the most popular search queries.

Junior Software Engineer, Deccan Retail Systems, Mysuru (2019 - 2021)
- Wrote REST services in Java for order tracking.

SKILLS
Java, Spring Boot, OpenSearch, Kafka, Redis, A/B testing, Python

EDUCATION
BE Computer Science, Visvesvaraya Technological University, 2019
